scripts.build: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build:main && pnpm run build:preload
scripts.dev: cross-env DESKTOP_ENV=development pnpm run build && cross-env DESKTOP_ENV=development electron .
scripts.package: pnpm run build && pnpm run prepare:wincodesign && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.dist: node scripts/prepare-resources.mjs && pnpm run build && pnpm run prepare:wincodesign && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.package:win: pnpm run build && pnpm run prepare:wincodesign && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.package:dir: pnpm run build && pnpm run prepare:wincodesign && electron-builder --dir --publish never
